tagline: Building production systems at the intersection of .NET Full Stack and AI/ML.
description: B.Tech CSE (AI/ML) graduate with production-level experience in .NET Full Stack engineering and Artificial Intelligence. Capgemini alumna. Ships clean, tested, deployed code.

roles.detailed: .NET Full Stack Engineer · AI/ML Developer · Data Analyst

bio: B.Tech graduate in Computer Science (AI/ML) with production-level experience in .NET Full Stack engineering — ASP.NET Core, Angular, Docker, AWS, CI/CD — and Artificial Intelligence, including LLMs, RAG pipelines, CNNs, and LangChain. Delivered two deployed applications, three AI/ML projects, and contributed to enterprise systems at Capgemini. Brings precision engineering habits — SOLID design, unit testing, API documentation — alongside the ability to move fast on ambiguous problems. Led GLA University's largest student club while shipping code.

bullets: Engineered 5+ ASP.NET Core Web API microservices following SOLID principles, reducing inter-service coupling and improving maintainability.
Built Angular frontend modules consuming RESTful APIs, improving end-user task completion flow.
Secured endpoints with JWT-based authentication and Entity Framework Core ORM with SQL Server, covering role-based access across user tiers.
Containerized services with Docker and configured Jenkins CI/CD pipelines on AWS, enabling consistent delivery cycles.
Participated in Agile sprints — authored technical docs, conducted peer code reviews, and coordinated with QA and design teams.
experience.desc: Full-stack engineering across ASP.NET Core microservices, Angular frontend, Docker, AWS, and Jenkins CI/CD for enterprise applications.

bullets: Fine-tuned open-source LLMs and built RAG pipelines using LangChain and Hugging Face, improving contextual AI accuracy for domain-specific queries.
Engineered structured prompts and evaluated output quality across 3+ model configurations to identify highest-accuracy deployment settings.
experience.desc: LLM fine-tuning, RAG pipeline construction, and prompt engineering for domain-specific AI applications.

bullets: Executed end-to-end analytics workflows — data extraction via SQL, transformation using R, and visualization in Tableau — producing dashboards for business reporting.
Cleaned and restructured datasets with 10,000+ records, applying statistical validation techniques to ensure reporting accuracy.
experience.desc: End-to-end data analytics: SQL extraction, R transformation, Tableau visualization, and statistical validation on large datasets.

bullets: Led GLA University's largest student society with 100+ members, directing programming, events, and membership growth.
Coordinated IBM Ice Day Technical Fest — managed 3-day event logistics and speaker coordination.
experience.desc: Led 100+ member student society, directed events, technical fests, and cross-functional team coordination.
